AC-01: validate protected requirement — A valid patch for `prototypes/fml-data-readiness/index.html` in a workspace where `prototypes/` does not exist passes preparation/validation while creating no directory or file.
AC-02: validate protected requirement — Applying the same valid new-file patch creates the required nested directories and file with exact expected content; no unrelated path is created.
AC-03: validate protected requirement — Two new-file patches under the same previously absent directory apply successfully without duplicate-directory failure.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — If a later patch in a multi-patch operation fails, previously committed nested new files are restored and newly created empty parent directories are removed; pre-existing or non-empty shared directories remain.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Symlink parents, non-directory parents, workspace escape, secret-sensitive targets/content, unsupported file suffixes and existing-file missing-parent cases remain rejected.
AC-06: validate protected requirement — A multi-patch request with target ancestry conflict is rejected before workspace mutation; ordinary sibling targets remain accepted.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — A transport exception followed by same-run revision N+1 is accepted as recovered server progress. Same revision, older revision, null run or different run is not accepted.
AC-08: validate protected requirement — `EngineeringAutonomyError` is surfaced directly and does not invoke ambiguity recovery.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — When recovered revision N+1 is autonomously continuable, continuation uses the new revision and existing request budget; the uncertain revision is never POSTed again.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Focused API/client tests, full API regression, client typecheck/state/export, Bounded Autonomy, protected promotion evaluation, Workstream Spec Validation and required DSPy validation pass on the exact PR head.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — After merge, exact application source reaches READY production deployment. `/health` and `/ready` return HTTP 200 with database/providers ready, and production preflights remain green.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Authenticated retry of Engineering Run `3a1ba66a-5649-42b6-81ee-91684fe06bbc` or an equivalent real nested-file build no longer fails merely because a valid new source file needs a previously absent parent directory. A mobile transport interruption with server-side revision advance reconciles to canonical state rather than showing only `Load failed`. Any later protected failure is diagnosed from its actual normalized reason rather than masked by these two limitations.

critique: The current implementation proposal rejects the safe patch boundary as `unsafe_target`. The current `TextPatchEngine._safe_target()` requires every parent directory to pre-exist, which means Parallax can create a new file only inside an already-existing directory. This is too restrictive for ordinary software development where a feature commonly introduces a new module, component, test, prototype or package directory.
